name: Mael Diaz
source:
“We haven't seen each other in some time. How are you?”

A court painter in direct service of the royal family.
His extraordinary talents have earned him many fans, all of whom will extol his skills with the arts.
His elusory nature, though, means he often doesn't appear in public. Very few have met him in person.

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/tempest/english/characters/?page=mael]the official site[/url]]
